answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 13578 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., 1. It is necessary to respond to 2nd Azaan before Starting Jumma Kutba by Imam during Friday Jumma Namaz. 2. Can you please confirm of my below understanding is correct. A. It is Wajib - Sitting to the extent of saying TASHAHHUD after two Rak?aats in Salaah of three or four Rak?aats. B. IT is Wajib - To read TASHAHHUD in the last QA'DAAS of Every Salah C. It is Farz - Sitting to the extent of saying TASHAHHUD in the last QA'DAAS of Every Salah 3. It is Wajib, to say TAKBEER (Allahu-Akbar) for QUNOOT in Witr Salaah and also it is necessary to recite DUA-E-QUNOOT. If one can recite ?Rabbanaa aatinaa to adhaaban naar? instead of Dua-e-Qunoot then they must necessary to do Sajda sow. Awaiting your quick reply Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., 1. It is necessary to respond to 2nd Azaan before Starting Jumma Kutba by Imam during Friday Jumma Namaz. 2. Can you please confirm of my below understanding is correct. A. It is Wajib - Sitting to the extent of saying TASHAHHUD after two Rak?aats in Salaah of three or four Rak?aats. B. IT is Wajib - To read TASHAHHUD in the last QA'DAAS of Every Salah C. It is Farz - Sitting to the extent of saying TASHAHHUD in the last QA'DAAS of Every Salah 3. It is Wajib, to say TAKBEER (Allahu-Akbar) for QUNOOT in Witr Salaah and also it is necessary to recite DUA-E-QUNOOT. If one can recite ?Rabbanaa aatinaa to adhaaban naar? instead of Dua-e-Qunoot then they must necessary to do Sajda sow. Awaiting your quick reply Answer ID: 13578 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 893/707=L /1430) One should not respond the azan called before khutbah of Jumu?ah, one only can respond in his heart: وینبغي أن لا یجیب بلسانہ اتفاقاً في الأذان بین یدي الخطیب (الدر المختار مع الشامي 2:70 ) (2) The rulings mentioned in the question from a-c are alright. (3) Saying Allahu Akbar for reciting qunoot is wajib according to one opinion, but the preferred opinion is that it is not wajib: وینبغي ترجیح عدم الوجوب لأنہ الأصل ولا دلیل علیہ (الشامي 2:163 ) It is not necessary in Witr to recite particular dua ( اللھم انا نستعینک ), rather it is sunnah, therefore if someone recites ربنا آتنا فی الدنیا حسنۃ الخ instead, he will not have to perform sajdah sahv (remedial sajdah). But, one who knows the qunoot by heart, he should not recite ربنا آتنا۔۔ . Yes, one who cannot recite the qunoot he can recite ربنا آتنا . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
